source_snapshot.procedure: Confirm known system/BIOS configuration and run `amd-smi topology` to map CPUs and GPUs to device indices.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES/read-only but insecure SSH and raw output only; no package/version, topology oracle or independent identity completeness.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires compatible AMD-SMI, recipe, authoritative CPU/GPU/BDF/NUMA map and normalized comparison.

old_problem: A successful topology command does not prove the expected relationships. The known recipe, AMD-SMI/driver compatibility, authoritative CPU/socket/NUMA/GPU/BDF map, index-reordering policy and `No show error` semantics are absent. DeepSeek returns raw output without completeness or identity validation.
disposition_reason: The read-only command and purpose are standard; missing expected topology is a Project Configuration oracle, not a review blocker. Numeric GPU indices are treated as ephemeral aliases anchored to immutable BDF/UUID/serial and socket/NUMA identity. Full AMD-SMI output is independently reconciled to OS/PCI inventory; no state change or log clearing is permitted.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2056, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2057 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00011-V002 / 8388c15a4674e9bb was directly read from XLSX.
AMD-SMI indices may reorder across boots, so they cannot be the authoritative device identity; every index must map to BDF plus approved GPU UUID/serial and CPU socket/NUMA.
Independent PCIe/CPU/NUMA/GPU inventory in the same time window proves completeness and catches missing, duplicate or wrong-socket relationships hidden by command success.
The signed recipe defines required nodes/edges and allowed index renumbering/unsupported fields; no expected topology is invented from the observed DUT.
`No show error` means clean exit, parseable complete output and zero policy-defined relationship/inventory discrepancies, with a human final verdict.
No host login, amd-smi/inventory command, package install, GPU reset/rebind, BIOS/configuration change, log clear or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: AMD-SMI topology reconciliation against immutable platform identity oracle
test_case.purpose: Verify the complete AMD-SMI CPU/GPU topology maps every observed device index to the correct immutable GPU BDF/UUID/serial, CPU socket and NUMA node required by the approved system/BIOS recipe, allowing only explicitly approved index reordering.
required_package: Exact row-2056 variant plus approved platform/system/BIOS configuration recipe
Compatible AMD-SMI/amdsmi, driver/kernel and firmware version matrix
Allowed index-reordering, unsupported-field and missing/duplicate/relationship policies
Protected read-only host access and approved independent PCIe/CPU/NUMA/GPU inventory commands
test_case.test_command: STRICTLY READ-ONLY; verify the approved recipe and tool/driver/kernel identities without installing or changing them. Through protected authenticated access, capture complete untruncated `amd-smi topology` with exit status and timestamp, then collect independent lspci/CPU/NUMA/GPU identity inventory in the same window. Normalize ephemeral AMD-SMI indices to immutable BDF/UUID/serial and compare every required device and relationship to the signed oracle, applying only documented reorder/unsupported-field rules. Do not clear logs, reset/rebind GPUs, change BIOS/driver/power or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: All required CPUs, sockets, NUMA nodes and GPUs appear exactly once; each ephemeral device index resolves to the correct immutable BDF/UUID/serial and approved socket/NUMA relationship, independent inventory agrees, and no unexpected/missing/duplicate relationship or tool error exists.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved recipe/tool/oracle, clean complete AMD-SMI output, independently complete inventory and zero disallowed topology differences. FAIL on command/parse error, missing/extra/duplicate identity, wrong BDF/socket/NUMA relation or unexplained index/field difference. Missing oracle/version policy is NOT READY; exit code or observed topology alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Read-only inventory only; do not install packages, change BIOS/driver/power, reset or rebind GPUs.
Use protected authentication and retain full untruncated outputs with redacted secrets.
Anchor comparisons to immutable identities, never numeric indices alone.
Stop on identity ambiguity, incomplete output or topology difference; no log clearing or automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and approved system/BIOS recipe
AMD-SMI/amdsmi, driver/kernel/firmware versions and signed topology oracle/policy
Independent PCIe/CPU/NUMA/GPU inventory with BDF/UUID/serial identities
Normalized expected-versus-observed node/relationship and missing/extra/duplicate comparison
test_case.recovery: On access, tool, identity or topology failure, stop read-only collection and preserve complete raw outputs/log context. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not reset/rebind, install/change packages or retry to alter enumeration; escalate the exact immutable identity/relationship discrepancy.

source_conflict.reason: A signed immutable topology oracle and independent inventory define `No show error` and replace raw-command success without guessing the expected DUT map.

blocked.reason: The read-only command, comparison, evidence and recovery are complete; recipe/tool/oracle are supplyable runtime Project inputs.

pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO IMMUTABLE TOPOLOGY-ORACLE COMPARISON; NO LOGIN, AMD-SMI/INVENTORY RUN, INSTALL, GPU/BIOS/POWER CHANGE, LOG CLEAR OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
